title.en: An Act Establishing A Public High School in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Talakag, Province of Bukidnon, To Be Known As the Talakag National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A Public High School in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Talakag, Province of Bukidnon, To Be Known As the Talakag National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Talakag Quốc gia tại Barangay San Isidro, Đô thị Talakag, Tỉnh Bukidnon, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Talakag แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ San Isidro เทศบาล Talakag จังหวัด Bukidnon และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Talakag Nasional di Barangay San Isidro, Kotamadya Talakag, Provinsi Bukidnon, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Talakag Kebangsaan di Barangay San Isidro, Perbandaran Talakag, Wilayah Bukidnon, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8325_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: A public high school in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Talakag, Province of Bukidnon, shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
